name: 阿莉莎·阿隆索
name_full: 阿莉莎·阿隆索 Alyssa Alonzo
introduction: Alyssa Alonzo is a Mexican-American actress born and raised in Fresno, California. She began creating content at a young age through YouTube before transitioning into on-camera acting in 2018, appearing in local short films and independent productions. Over the years, she has continued to develop her craft through a variety of roles, building experience in film while refining her screen presence and emotional range. Alyssa is passionate about storytelling and is dedicated to growing her career in film and television.
